assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, flood control, fire safety and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package supports concept review and package-level self-check only; statutory controls and professional responsibility remain pending confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Railway history, station references, historical images, archives, portraits, enterprise marks, fonts and cultural materials require item-level rights review before public reuse.
assumptions.impact: The package uses original concept diagrams and text summaries only; external visual assets are not embedded and any future asset must be added to the rights ledger.

assumptions.statement: Operators, partners, funding, permits and maintenance responsibilities in the project and RACI tables are concept roles until written authorization is available.
assumptions.impact: The package can describe interfaces and acceptance KPIs but cannot promise an institution, event, service or construction delivery.

assumptions.statement: Accessibility continuity, walking gaps, public-service demand, building use, industry space demand and cultural-resource inventories require local, citable surveys; background-only sources cannot stand in for them.
assumptions.impact: Inclusion and service rules are design safeguards and pilot measures, not claims about current local conditions.

assumptions.statement: Raw provisional geometry metrics are retained for deterministic recalculation but human-facing drawings and HTML display rounded values with an adjacent provisional-geometry warning.
assumptions.impact: Audit precision is intentionally separated from planning precision; official polygon replacement requires full recalculation.

assumptions.statement: The bilingual equivalence table checks claims, metrics, sources, warnings, figure numbers and positions; it is a package review record, not a certified translation or legal opinion.
assumptions.impact: Human sign-off remains required for professional publication or formal use.
